.. change::
    :tags: bug, orm
    :tickets: 13799

    Fixed issue where criteria added to a relationship using
    :meth:`.PropComparator.and_` within :func:`_orm.lazyload`,
    :func:`_orm.selectinload` or :func:`_orm.subqueryload` would also be
    applied to further relationship loads of the same entity beneath that
    relationship, such as the next level of a self-referential relationship,
    filtering the collections at those levels as well.  The criteria now
    applies only to the relationship that the loader option refers to, as was
    already the case for :func:`_orm.joinedload`, so that additional rows may
    be loaded at deeper levels.  To apply the criteria to subsequent levels,
    :meth:`.PropComparator.and_` may be added to the loader option for each
    level, or in the case of :func:`_orm.selectinload`,
    :paramref:`_orm.selectinload.recursion_depth` may be used, where the
    criteria continues to apply to each level loaded by that recursion.
